## Endpoints

### Data Read (2)
- `POST /voice/v1/voiceclient/billing/ratetable/get` — Get Google Voice billing rate for a specific number.
- `POST /voice/v1/voiceclient/billing/specialrulesbillingcountries/list` — List countries with special billing rules for Google Voice.

## Quick Start

```typescript
// Get the billing rate for a specific phone number.
async function getBillingRate(phoneNumber: string) {
  try {
    const response = await client.voice.v1.voiceclient.billing.ratetable.get({
      phoneNumber: phoneNumber,
    });
    console.log("Billing rate:", response.rate);
    return response.rate;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error getting billing rate:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// List countries with special billing rules.
async function listSpecialBillingCountries() {
  try {
    const response = await client.voice.v1.voiceclient.billing.specialrulesbillingcountries.list();
    console.log("Countries with special billing rules:", response.countries);
    return response.countries;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error listing special billing countries:", error);
    return [];
  }
}
```
